title: Power ranking: the best wonderkids under 20
checked: Under 20 = born after 4 Nov 2006: Yamal 13 Jul 2007, Cubarsi 22 Jan 2007, Kostoulas 31 Jan 2007, Vuskovic 25 Feb 2007, Bouaddi 2 Oct 2007 (Yahoo: 19), Karl 22 Feb 2008 (trackers), Estevao 24 Apr 2007, Mastantuono 14 Aug 2007, Mora 5 May 2007, Karetsas 19 Nov 2007 (Wikipedia, BVB; at Dortmund since Aug 2026). Kroupi was dropped: born 23 June 2006, so he is 20 (11v11, Soccerway). Lewis-Skelly, Hato, Zaire-Emery, Endrick and Rayan are 20, so left out. All nine below Yamal are 2026 Golden Boy finalists (goldenboyaward.com, Yahoo; Mastantuono on loan at Fiorentina). Spain 1-0 Argentina after extra time, 19 July 2026; Cubarsi FIFA Best Young Player, beating Yamal (Blueprint, Football Espana). Cubarsi 12th, Yamal 3rd in the Ballon d'Or, Yamal's third Kopa Trophy (Wikipedia, Yahoo). Yamal Barcelona's youngest to 50 goals, at 19 years 49 days, v Rayo (FC Barcelona, World Soccer Talk); Messi was 21. Karl thigh injury kept him out of the World Cup (beIN, Bulinews); one league goal this season (three trackers). Kostoulas 3 PL goals, Vuskovic 1 (NBC); Brighton third with 24 goals, City second (Wikipedia). Order is our judgement, never a game rating. No gameplay: Barcelona's stripes cannot be drawn in the game figures.

lines.text: In July, two nineteen-year-olds won the World Cup for Spain. These are the ten best footballers in the world under twenty.
Spain beat Argentina one-nil in the final, after extra time.

scene.note: Spain are world champions for the second time

lines.text: Ten, Konstantinos Karetsas, now at Dortmund. Nine, Rodrigo Mora of Roma. Eight, Franco Mastantuono, on loan at Fiorentina.
lines.say: Ten, Konstanteenos Karetsas, now at Dortmund. Nine, Rodreego Morra, of Roma. Eight, Franco Mastantwonoh, on loan at Fyorenteena.

lines.text: Seven, Chelsea's Estêvão. Six, Lennart Karl: born in 2008, injured for the World Cup, and back scoring for Bayern.
lines.say: Seven, Chelsea's Eshtehvow. Six, Lennart Karl: born in two thousand and eight, injured for the World Cup, and back scoring for Bayern.

lines.text: Five, Ayyoub Bouaddi, in midfield for a City side second in the table. Four, Luka Vušković, scoring from centre-back for Brighton.
lines.say: Five, Ayoob Boowaddee, in midfield for a City side second in the table. Four, Looka Vooshkovitch, scoring from centre-back for Brighton.

lines.text: Number three. Brighton's Greek teenager, Kostoulas.
lines.say: Number three. Brighton's Greek teenager, Kostoolas.

lines.text: Three Premier League goals, for a Brighton side sitting third, with more goals than anyone.
Number two. Pau Cubarsí, of Barcelona.
lines.say: Number two. Pow Koobarsee, of Barcelona.

lines.text: A World Cup winner, the tournament's Best Young Player, and twelfth in the Ballon d'Or. He's the Golden Boy favourite.
lines.say: A World Cup winner, the tournament's Best Young Player, and twelfth in the Balon Dor. He's the Golden Boy favourite.

lines.text: And number one. Obviously. Lamine Yamal.
lines.say: And number one. Obviously. Lahmeen Yamahl.

lines.text: World champion, third in the Ballon d'Or, and a third Kopa Trophy in a row.
lines.say: World champion, third in the Balon Dor, and a third Kohpa Trophy in a row.

lines.text: Against Rayo Vallecano, he became the youngest player to score fifty goals for Barcelona. Messi was twenty-one.
lines.say: Against Rahyo Vayekano, he became the youngest player to score fifty goals for Barsah. Messi was twenty-one.

scene.headline: Yamal becomes Barcelona's youngest 50-goal man
scene.standfirst: At 19 years and 49 days, he passes Lionel Messi, who reached 50 Barcelona goals at 21.
